issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B interval Equal/Equivalent and Start/End semantics
issues.evidence: Translated Interval(1, 6] = Interval[2, 6] and equivalent returned false because the translator compared raw interval JSON/text shape.
issues.root_cause: Generic equality/equivalence lowering treated interval-valued SQL as scalar JSON/text instead of comparing semantic effective Start/End boundaries.
issues.resolution: Added intervalEquals/intervalEquivalent helper surfaces and routed translated interval =, !=, ~, and !~ through them.
issues.verification: Verified by HISTORIAN probe, interval Part 1 parity tests, focused interval/public-surface pytest, CQL pytest slice, and full conformance 2822/2822.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B precision-qualified interval operators over Date/DateTime values
issues.evidence: Precision-aware interval helpers over partial Date/DateTime values returned definite booleans in native/no-Python paths where the relationship was unknown.
issues.root_cause: Direct helper implementations coerced imprecise comparison uncertainty to false or true instead of propagating SQL NULL.
issues.resolution: Updated Python fallback and native C++ precision-aware interval helpers to return NULL for partial Date/DateTime uncertainty and registered Python-preferred shadowing for conformance-sensitive native-loaded paths.
issues.verification: Verified by HISTORIAN probe across forced Python, native-loaded, and no-Python C++ surfaces plus focused interval parity tests.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B interval Ends same-boundary null behavior
issues.evidence: No-Python direct C++ intervalEndsSame returned false for a missing high boundary instead of NULL.
issues.root_cause: Native C++ same-boundary helpers used direct boolean comparison without first validating that the required interval boundary existed.
issues.resolution: Updated native C++ intervalStartsSame and intervalEndsSame to return SQL NULL when the required boundary is absent.
issues.verification: Verified by HISTORIAN probe, no-Python direct helper parity coverage, native C++ unittest, and focused interval/public-surface pytest.
